line: Tell a friend you're proud of them.
paragraph: A child traded his most valuable Pokémon cards at a convention in San Francisco. The adult on the other side of the deal took the cards and gave nothing back. His father, a venture capitalist named Eric Bahn, told others at the August 29th event what had happened. Strangers on the convention floor gathered new cards to give the boy. They replaced what he lost, and more. A father watched his son receive the help of people he had never met.

seed.summary: A heartwarming story of a community putting values above value comes from the convention floor of Pokémon XP.
